intelligence.title: 662 Beginnings, 5 Endings
intelligence.essence: On 2026-10-20 the team censused its own brain: 662 open changes, 473 untouched 7+ days, 229 created vs 49 merged in 7 days (4.7 starts per finish), headline scores frozen a week. Not a queue but a reservoir: starting was free, finishing ran through one serial bottleneck, closing was nobody's job, no report printed the pile. Seven root causes named; prevention with teeth: every open item gets an owner plus exactly one disposition (merge / fix its one named gap / close), per-lane WIP caps, creation budget = last week's completions + 2, 14-day list / 21-day close, reservoir metrics printed nightly, completions as the only reported metric.

connections.note: The reservoir drain (finish-or-close every item) is governed by the completion doctrine.
